acceptanceCriteria: The failure is reproduced or bounded by repeated archive export runs on a 10k-ticket store, its cause is recorded, and a regression test covers the fix.
archive export passes repeatedly at 10k tickets.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

From the scale-tasks lane (V1-0893), 2026-10-06, corvint-tasks built from origin/main 76f7f2ac plus that lane's commit: one of three archive export runs on a synthetic 10k-ticket store exited rc=1; the other two passed. Not investigated; logs under /private/tmp/claude-501/td-scale-tasks/. Suspected defect, not yet reproduced.
title: corvint-tasks archive export intermittently exits rc=1 on a 10k-ticket store
